script_rows.visual_text: Wide shot: Urban apartment, early morning. Sunlight streaming through windows. TALENT (30s, professional) wakes up groggy, reaches for alarm clock.
script_rows.audio_text:
SFX: Alarm buzzing
MUSIC: Soft, building instrumental

script_rows.visual_text: Medium shot: Kitchen counter. TALENT opens refrigerator, pulls out ACME ENERGY DRINK can. Product hero shot with condensation.
script_rows.audio_text:
SFX: Refrigerator opening, can crack
MUSIC: Energy builds

script_rows.visual_text: Close-up: TALENT drinks. Expression transforms from tired to energized. Eyes brighten.
script_rows.audio_text:
VO: "Acme Energy. The boost you need."
MUSIC: Peak energy

script_rows.visual_text: Montage: TALENT moving through morning routine with energy - shower, getting dressed, grabbing bag. Quick cuts, dynamic movement.
script_rows.audio_text:
MUSIC: Upbeat, driving tempo
SFX: Quick whoosh transitions

script_rows.visual_text: Wide shot: City street. TALENT walks confidently to work, passing others who look tired. TALENT smiles, energetic stride.
script_rows.audio_text:
VO: "Start your day the Acme way."
MUSIC: Continues upbeat

script_rows.visual_text: Medium shot: Office environment. TALENT enters, greets colleagues enthusiastically. Others react positively.
script_rows.audio_text:
SFX: Office ambience, greetings
MUSIC: Settling to confident tone

script_rows.visual_text:
Product shot: ACME ENERGY DRINK can on desk, office in soft focus behind. Logo prominent.
SUPER: "ACME ENERGY - BOOST YOUR MORNING"
SUPER: "Available everywhere"
script_rows.audio_text:
VO: "Acme Energy. Available everywhere."
MUSIC: Resolve to tagline sting

script_rows.visual_text:
End card: ACME logo center frame, product can beside it.
SUPER: "acme-energy.com"
LEGAL: "Drink responsibly. Not for children under 16."
script_rows.audio_text:
MUSIC: Final tag
SFX: Subtle energy whoosh
